explanation: At GO it is nearly maxed (10 early in the episode, 9 by mid-episode, 6-7 after about trial 85); at D1 it is 8-10 after an unrewarded trial, but after a rewarded trial it is about 6 while the agent has been choosing a1, about 2 while it has been choosing a2, and 0-1 late in the episode. At D2 it is about 7-8 after a common transition (dropping to 4-5 late in the episode), 9 after a rare a1-to-S2 transition, and low (5 mid-episode, 2-3 late) after a rare a2-to-S1 transition.
